recognize_zh: 視野中央有一個細長彎曲、內含深色瘧色素的蟲體（香蕉形/新月形配子體，crescent gametocyte），這種形狀是惡性瘧原蟲（Plasmodium falciparum）的特徵；周圍為骨髓系細胞與血小板團。
features: Central elongated, crescent/banana-shaped parasite with dark clumped hemozoin pigment, characteristic of a P. falciparum gametocyte
Host red cell outline largely inapparent around the elongated organism
Surrounding red cells without obvious ring forms in this field
Admixed myeloid cells (myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils) and a platelet clump, consistent with a marrow aspirate
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single elongated, crescent-shaped intraerythrocytic parasite with dark central pigment, morphologically consistent with a Plasmodium falciparum gametocyte. Surrounding myeloid precursors and neutrophils appear unremarkable, and a platelet clump is present. Ring forms are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with falciparum malaria; parasitemia should be quantified on thick and thin peripheral blood films.

ddx.vs: Vivax and ovale gametocytes are round to oval and fill an enlarged red cell with Schuffner dots, rather than being crescent-shaped.
Babesia produces small ring forms and tetrads (Maltese cross) without hemozoin pigment or banana-shaped gametocytes.

ddx.dx: Platelet or stain precipitate overlying a red cell
ddx.vs: Overlying platelets or precipitate lack the defined crescent cytoplasm with internal pigment and are often in a different focal plane.
